=== registers by name
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	pushq %rbp
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_offset %rbp, -16
	movq %rsp, %rbp
	.cfi_def_cfa_register %rbp
	pushq %r15
	.cfi_offset r15, -24
	.cfi_offset %xmm15, -32
	.cfi_offset %ymm16, -40
	.cfi_offset %st(0), -48
	.cfi_offset %mm7, -56
	.cfi_offset %k7, -64
	.cfi_register %rip, %rax
	.cfi_same_value %rflags
	.cfi_undefined %fs.base
	.cfi_undefined %mxcsr, %es, %gs
	popq %r15
	popq %rbp
	.cfi_def_cfa %rsp, 8
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
=== instructions a CIE can take
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_offset %rbx, -16
	.cfi_register %rip, %rax
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_offset %rbx, -16
	.cfi_register %rip, %rax
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	.cfi_endproc
h:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_remember_state
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_restore_state
	.cfi_endproc
k:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_escape 0x2e, 0x10
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
m:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_offset %rbx, -16
	.cfi_register %rip, %rax
	.cfi_restore %rbx
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== a C++ frame
	.text
	.globl f
f:
.LFB0:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x9b,DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0
	.cfi_lsda 0x1b,.LLSDA0
	pushq %rbx
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_offset 3, -16
	call g@PLT
	popq %rbx
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
	.section .gcc_except_table,"a",@progbits
.LLSDA0:
	.byte 0xff
	.byte 0xff
	.byte 0x1
	.uleb128 0
	.hidden DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0
	.weak DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0
	.section .data.rel.local,"aw",@progbits
	.align 8
	.type DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0, @object
	.size DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0, 8
DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0:
	.quad __gxx_personality_v0
=== a simple frame in .debug_frame
	.cfi_sections .debug_frame
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc simple
	.cfi_def_cfa %rsp, 8
	.cfi_offset %rip, -8
	pushq %rbp
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 8
	.cfi_rel_offset %rbp, 0
	popq %rbp
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset -8
	.cfi_restore %rbp
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
=== views
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 1 view -0
	.loc 1 2 view .LVU1
	nop
	.loc 1 3 view .LVU2
	.loc 1 4 view .LVU3
	nop
	.loc 1 5 view 0
	nop
	.loc 1 6 view -0
	nop
	.section .debug_info,"",@progbits
	.uleb128 .LVU1
	.uleb128 .LVU2
	.byte .LVU3
	.long .LVU3 + 5
=== a view reset where the previous row is
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1 view -0
	nop
	.loc 1 2 view .LVU1
	.loc 1 3 view -0
	nop
=== rows for labels
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.loc_mark_labels 1
	.text
	.loc 1 5 2
	nop
a:
	nop
b:	.loc 1 6
c:	nop
	.loc_mark_labels 0
d:	nop
	.data
e:	.long 0
=== a loc outside code
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.data
	.loc 1 5
	.long 1
	.text
	nop
	.loc 1 6
	nop
=== DWARF 5 with the same file as file 0 and file 1

	.text

	nop
	.loc 2 30 1
	nop
	.loc 3 6 3
	nop
=== DWARF 5 file 0 in the working directory
	.file 0 "/build" "main.c"
	.file 1 "main.c"
	.file 2 "/build/inc/a.h"

	.loc 1 5 21
	nop
	.loc 2 30 1
	nop
=== a file named again
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.file 2 "dir/b.c"
	.file 2 "dir/b.c"
	.text
	.loc 2 5
	nop
